capstoneSequence.scope: The online capstone requires senior status, HIST 300 and one course from a published upper-level history list. The online academic policy defines senior status at 72 earned semester credits. This named baseline satisfies the second course prerequisite with HIEU 322; it does not require every alternative.

notes: Baseline keeps UNIV 104 at three credits and retains both conditional religion-waiver requirements.
The published course sequence uses HIUS 221 and GEOG 200 in information literacy. Each is allocated once to its foundational requirement and also fulfils the corresponding general-education position.

The eight major elective selections are distinct, three-credit upper-level courses explicitly offered online. These are proposed choices within the published department/level restrictions, not mandatory choices for every History student.
Thirty upper-level credits are carried by the major: HIST 300, HIST 491 and eight named upper-level history electives.
The complete 42-credit Major Requirements ledger is the retained major-residency basis; this does not create a separate minimum for every history subject.
Upper-level GEOG courses in free electives are strongly recommended, not required. This baseline does not turn that recommendation into a mandatory block.
This History degree is not represented as a teacher-licensure program.
